## Payment & insurance model (important differentiator)
Healing Hands is an out-of-network, private-pay (cash-pay) clinic by design. By not contracting with insurance, the practice can give every client a full hour of one-on-one, customized, hands-on care that is not dictated by insurance parameters. The care plan is decided by the patient and the doctor — not by an insurer. A superbill can be provided for patients to submit to their insurance for possible out-of-network reimbursement. This contrasts with typical insurance-based PT, where a therapist may see three patients an hour and visits are dominated by aides and repetitive gym exercises.

## Philosophy
A holistic approach that treats the whole person — body, mind, and soul. The goal is to help active adults who feel lost in traditional medicine get back to doing what they love (gardening, pickleball, running, yoga, golf, playing with the kids), while avoiding unnecessary surgery and injections whenever possible. "SOLUTION-based care" — finding and treating the root cause of pain, with bodywork first for relief and lasting results.

## Services (full)
1. Concierge Physical Therapy — A full hour, one-on-one with your doctor at every visit. Evaluation of gait, posture, and mobility; hands-on treatment; personalized home program; direct phone/text/email access to your doctor.
2. Manual Therapy & Bodywork — Hands-on techniques: joint mobilizations, soft-tissue mobilization, myofascial release, muscle energy technique, strain/counterstrain, CranioSacral therapy. Analyzes gait/posture/mobility to find the root cause and decrease compensatory movement.
3. Dry Needling — A thin filiform needle releases tight tissue and reaches myofascial trigger points within the muscle that hands can't. NOT acupuncture (acupuncture is Traditional Chinese Medicine / meridian-energy based). Reactivates immobile muscles and relieves pain.
4. CranioSacral Therapy (CST) — A gentle, light-touch therapy that assists the movement of cerebrospinal fluid to relieve tension in the central nervous system, promote well-being, ease pain, and support health and immunity.
5. StemWave Therapy — A noninvasive, FDA-listed regenerative therapy using acoustic waves; the latest, more powerful evolution of shockwave therapy (used in medical offices 20+ years). Increases blood flow, reduces inflammation. Drug-free, no downtime, minimal side effects. Great for osteoarthritis, tendonitis, and soft-tissue injuries; has helped many avoid surgery.
6. Myofascial Release — Gentle-to-deep engagement of the fascia to release restrictions; reduces soreness, improves tissue recovery and circulation, increases joint range of motion, decreases effects of stress.
7. Muscle Energy Technique (MET) — A gentle approach using ~2 lbs of the patient's own muscle force to mobilize joint restrictions, balance muscle tone, stretch tight / strengthen weak muscles, improve circulation, and reduce pain.
8. Cupping — Plastic cups suction the tissue and drag lightly to release tissues and improve circulation.
9. Visceral Mobilization — Gentle, specifically-placed manual forces that restore normal mobility, tone, and motion of the viscera and surrounding connective tissue.

Additional hands-on techniques used: Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation (PNF) and rehabilitation / exercise education.

## Pricing & how to start
- Intro session — $150 (one hour, hands-on): the recommended first step. A real working visit where Dr. Jamie treats you and builds a custom root-cause plan, then recommends the best path.
- Packages: a short series of sessions (priced at your intro — ask in person).
- Maintenance Membership — $97/month: 10% off services, a credit toward your first session, same-day access for new injuries, and priority booking. For staying ahead of pain after the root cause is fixed (the body needs ongoing upkeep, not one-and-done).
- StemWave add-on — ~$49: a quick 10–15 minute sonic/acoustic-wave (shockwave) booster layered onto any visit.
- Booking: self-serve online scheduling at https://healinghandspt.janeapp.com/ (Jane), or call/text (775) 452-4471. Prices are provisional and confirmed at booking; no surprise bills.
